definition.simple: Any plant that grows where it is not wanted, especially in a farm, and steals food from the main crop.
definition.academic: Undesirable and uncultivated plants that grow naturally along with the crop, competing for nutrients, space, light, and water.

common_misconceptions: All non-crop plants are useless. (Some might have medicinal value, but they are weeds if they compete with the crop.)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student to think of a weed as an uninvited guest at a dinner party who eats all the food.
